summary: PDF specification download implementation with passing automated checks and an explicit outstanding manual reader/assistive-technology verification gap.

checks.title: Complete A4 and Letter download controls
checks.detail: r1: accepted and older snapshot PDF downloads completed through Chromium user controls, despite a search filter. Information-only and empty-source capture paths checked. Markdown and JSON paths retained.

checks.title: Coherent saved contexts
checks.detail: r1: immutable capture excludes staged values; older snapshot output retains frozen body/section/status fields after current edits. Unit checks retain unknown legacy version and isolate copies.

checks.title: Complete rich content and supporting fields
checks.detail: r1: 100-item fixture, literal 50,000-code-point body, Markdown/HTML/code/tables, all criteria, parameters, tags, dependencies and ten summary sources passed text checks. Main inline-reading regressions passed.

checks.title: Paginated layout and page images
checks.detail: r1: A4 154 pages and Letter 165 pages for each accepted/snapshot fixture. Every page rendered; full contact sheets and representative detailed pages inspected. Text bounds checks passed; wide column bands and tall-row continuations retain headers. Body 11pt, secondary >=9pt, line spacing 1.4, margins 46pt.

checks.title: PDF navigation
checks.detail: r1: 30 link annotations per sample resolve to safe external targets or valid named PDF destinations; contents, section/item outlines, dependency/source and figure/detail links are included.

checks.title: Vector figures and explicit fallback
checks.detail: r1: Mermaid flowchart/sequence/state and grouped/directed/undirected DOT rendered; large graph uses linked overview and four overlapping readable details. Legacy failure and oversized figure tests preserve full source and identify item/block warnings.

checks.title: Searchable text and structural accessibility checks
checks.detail: r1: pypdf checks Unicode extraction, embedded subsets with ToUnicode, language/title, heading/list/table/link/figure tags, column-header scope, figure alternatives, annotation structure references and unrestricted offline file contents. This automated result does not assert a screen-reader or PDF/UA certification pass.

checks.title: Local read-only generation and safe content
checks.detail: r1: no external conversion service or generation endpoint; allowlisted HTML/SVG reused, safe credential-free HTTP(S) links only, source-context-scoped bounded SVG cache. Tests confirm no authored external fetch and unchanged workspace records after generation, cancellation and failures.

checks.title: Progress, cancellation and recovery
checks.detail: r1: accessible Preparing/Ready/warning/failure states, duplicate activation, cancellation, font failure, 120-second deadline, project switching, blocked automatic download and Download again exercised. Unit checks reject empty/oversized input and oversized figures retain source.

checks.title: Complete release verification matrix
checks.detail: r1: automated download/text/structure/layout and regression checks passed. Native Preview inspection was attempted twice but computer access timed out (-10005). Desktop-reader/assistive-technology interaction, PDF keyboard navigation in a reader, and physical/grayscale print-preview checks remain unexecuted. Do not treat these as passing.

limits: Synthetic fixtures and local loopback D1 were used; production project content was not altered by testing.
All 638 layout pages were rendered locally. Full page PNGs and contact sheets remain under outputs/pdf; representative contact sheets accompany the published evidence.
Source capture and snapshot comparisons use MCP readback. Lifecycle/evidence changes are distinct from implementation assertions.
Unexecuted native-reader and assistive checks are retained as an incomplete WW-108 result.
